notes: Configuration and unit levels use force_spread.py's configurations, drawn near the unrelaxed registry cell from the five-model mean FCs; the PBE set uses C3b's configurations (rattled baseline and owner-model SSCHA ensembles), so the two sets of configurations are not the same and the PBE set does not contain the wrong consensus units themselves.

Force RMS over all components is dominated by the stiff modes; a stability call depends on the soft-mode curvature and well depth, which C3a (PBE along the screen's own coordinates) addresses. The decomposition says what the spread can see of the force error, not of the call.
Spearman is the Pearson correlation of pandas average ranks (no scipy). Clustered intervals resample whole systems (stats._blocks, 10000 resamples, seed 0).
